text:
anya (People Ops): Heads-up 1: some interviewers say the scorecard they get in the panel invite is missing the competency rubric column ("Impact"). Noticed on roles in Platform Eng.
mike (Recruiter Ops): saw this for candidates 6012/6013. The web form shows the header but the radio options are gone.
sara (Hiring Manager): that field is critical for calibration. We had 3 reviewers today confused about where to put the Impact rating.
leo (Interview Training): thanks. Did we push a template change recently? I rolled out a condensed scorecard last week for faster completion. Could be related.
triage-bot: deploy:scorecard-template-compact v1.1 deployed at 1795558000 by infra-bot.
mike (Recruiter Ops): compact template removed optional columns but apparently a rendering bug hides the whole rubric when conditional logic triggers (team=platform and role!=ic3).
anya (People Ops): urgent ask: can we restore full rubric for all active panels until we confirm template logic? we should avoid losing data points this week.
leo (Interview Training): quick mitigation: I can flip a feature flag to revert to previous template across prod for 10m while we patch. That will be fast. Anyone object?
sara (Hiring Manager): do it. We're mid-calibration and need consistent fields.
mike (Recruiter Ops): also request a migration to backfill missing Impact responses for yesterday's 3 panels; we have transcriptions from the debriefs that could be mapped.
leo (Interview Training): agreed on backfill but prefer to log an incident and validate before writing data. I'll add instrumentation to count missing Impact field submissions (event: scorecard.submit.missing_impact).
triage-bot: incident created: OPS-2026-314 "scorecard-rubric-hidden-after-template-compact" assigned to leo.
anya (People Ops): thanks. Also please add a temporary banner on candidate pages for affected roles: "Scorecard fields were incomplete for some panels yesterday; if you notice missing items please contact People Ops." I'll prep a short email to the hiring teams once you confirm revert.
leo (Interview Training): feature flag reverted at 1795560000. Monitoring. Patch plan: fix conditional logic in template renderer and add a unit test for conditional hiding. Will release 1.2 after tests.
mike (Recruiter Ops): confirmed Impact column visible again for candidates 6012/6013. I'll hold off on backfill until you post counts.
anya (People Ops): perfect. I'll send the note to hiring leads and ask reviewers to re-open any incomplete scorecards so they can add Impact if needed.
leo (Interview Training): follow-up: added log for scorecard.render.missing_fields and scheduled patch release for 1795563600. Will update incident with counts after 30m.
sara (Hiring Manager): thanks everyone. Appreciate the quick revert.
mike (Recruiter Ops): verified no regressions in feedback pipeline after revert. :thumbsup:
